_provenance: Numbers produced by MATLAB R2026a LTE Toolbox NB-IoT functions (NPSS/NSSS/NRS/NPBCH/NPDCCH/NPDSCH symbol and index functions, public API calls only, no MathWorks code) for TS 36.141 6.1.3-6.1.6 N-TM frames (n_f = 0, all-zero data); trimmed by the OpenDPD 2.4.1 NR test-model work.  QPSK-valued symbols are stored as codes 0..3 = (re < 0) + 2 (im < 0) of (+-1 +-j)/sqrt(2); RE sets are hex bit masks of bit l*12+k (k subcarrier, l symbol); the MATLAB index lists were checked to be in mapping order (increasing k, then l) before trimming.  Complex floats are rounded to 13 decimals.  NSSS values of MATLAB carry an argument-reduction error of up to 8e-12 against the exact definition.
_format: cases[name]: mode, n_id, host_cell_id; budgets['1'] = one NRS port (MATLAB NBRefP=1), ['2'] = 2-port budget (NBRefP=2, 304/200 bits); per subframe sf[0..9]: nrs = [[bit index, qpsk code]] of port 2000 (absent in 5, 9), nrs1 = bit indices of the muted port-2001 NRS (budget 2), ch = hex mask of the channel REs (NPBCH sf0, NPDCCH sf1, NPDSCH 2-4/6-8, NPSS 5, NSSS 9), sym = qpsk codes of that channel in mapping order (budget 2 only for cases listed in g_cases: MATLAB called with the 200/304-bit codeword), npss/nsss = complex values in mapping order.
